skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers (or a mixed number and a whole number) where the fractional part of the minuend is greater than or equal to the subtrahend's fractional part, involving separating whole and fraction parts, subtracting each, and combining the result.

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers with regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers where the fractional part of the minuend is less than the subtrahend's, requiring borrowing one from the whole number and adding the denominator to the numerator before subtracting.

skills.name: Convert fractions to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two or more denominators and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers in the subtraction problem.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, convert one unit from the whole part into a fraction with the same denominator and add it to the fraction part, then subtract. This may need to be repeated if the resulting fraction is still negative.

skills.name: Combine whole and fraction
skills.definition: Write the final answer as a mixed number or integer by combining the whole part and fraction part after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with like denominators
skills.definition: Given two fractions with the same denominator, subtract the numerators and keep the denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator, convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator, then subtract the numerators.

skills.name: Handle whole number parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole number parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers, and perform borrowing (renaming) when the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, including cases where the minuend is a whole number.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor, including converting a zero fraction to zero.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator of two fractions and rewrite each as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions with a common denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the whole number parts of mixed numbers (or a whole number and a mixed number's whole part).

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, take 1 from the whole part, convert it to a fraction with the same denominator, add to the fraction part, then subtract.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Convert improper fraction in mixed number
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fraction part as a proper mixed number (e.g., 2 3/2 becomes 3 1/2).

skills.name: Represent number as mixed number
skills.definition: Write a whole number as a mixed number with fraction 0 (e.g., 3 = 3 0/5) or a pure fraction as a mixed number with whole part 0 (e.g., 1/8 = 0 1/8).

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract one whole number from another, including when they are part of a mixed number.

skills.name: Borrow from whole
skills.definition: Decrease the whole number part by 1, add the denominator to the fraction numerator, and re-evaluate the fraction subtraction when the initial fraction result is negative.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.
